text:
Ashley (PM): Kicking off thread — we need to finalize cohort size + success metrics for the private preview. Goal: get actionable feedback on Dedicated onboarding and rollout policy. Thinking 10–15 customers, 6-week cohort. Thoughts?
Jamal (Recruiter): 10–15 sounds right. We can target 12 with a 20% no-show buffer -> invite 15. Target profiles: AI-native startups (seed/Series A), midmarket platform teams, plus 2 regulated (finance/health).
Olivia (Research): Agree. Success metrics: time-to-first-success (integration -> first inference), signal quality (NPS-style), latency p50/p95, error rate, and feature-request triage count. Propose primary metric = time-to-first-success <= 3 days.
Marco (Eng): Capacity check: we can support 12 concurrent private installs but need a rolling start to avoid spikes. Also want to exercise 2 model/quantization variants to test routing/fallback. Re: instrumentation, add route-level tracing + per-token cost logging.
Tina (Design): Onboarding plan: 1-hour onboarding call + a checklist + pre-populated config repo. Feedback cadence: weekly 3-question survey + 2 structured interviews (wk2 & wk5). Keep surveys <5 mins.
Jamal (Recruiter): Draft screening snippet we can paste into Typeform/HubSpot: 
```
Company stage: [Seed/Series A/Mid/Enterprise]
Primary use case: [chat/embeddings/rerank/search/other]
Data sensitivity: [low/medium/high]
Expected qps: [<10 / 10-100 / >100]
Deployment preference: [hosted/dedicated/private]
Why interested (1-2 lines):
Commitment: Can join weekly check-ins? [yes/no]
```
Olivia (Research): Add: "Do you require on-prem or VPC? Any compliance constraints (e.g., HIPAA, SOC2)?" Also capture 3 representative prompts or queries to build eval sets.
Ashley (PM): Launch gates (must pass all): 1) at least one production route instrumented and smoke-tested; 2) security checklist signed; 3) agreed evaluation prompt set uploaded. If any missing, candidate goes to waitlist.
Marco (Eng): Can we define 'time-to-first-success' precisely? Suggest: measured from invite-accept timestamp -> first successful inference that meets smoke eval (non-error + passes simple relevance test).
Tina (Design): Feedback triage ownership: Product owns prioritization; Olivia owns qualitative analysis; Marco owns telemetry/ops signals; Jamal runs recruitment ops.
Jamal (Recruiter): Timeline proposal: outreach week of Apr 25, rolling onboarding over 2 weeks, cohort active May 9–Jun 20. That smooths capacity and gives 6 weeks of feedback.
Ashley (PM): Incentives: $2k platform credit + priority engineering support (2 dedicated eng hours/week during onboarding window) + optional co-marketing/quote. Acceptable?
Olivia (Research): Agree. Also add an opt-in telemetry consent checkbox and a two-sentence privacy blurb.
deploy-bot: Reminder: schedule onboarding calls via the shared calendar. (automated)
Marco (Eng): Action items: I'll draft the rollout plan + infra capacity doc and flag any blocking kernel/quantization work. Ashley: can you author the evaluation prompt list draft by Wed?
Ashley (PM): Yep, will do. Jamal, please start candidate list + Typeform template.
Tina (Design): I'll draft the week-1 onboarding checklist and two interview scripts (integration health + UX follow-ups).
Jamal (Recruiter): Noted. I'll target 20 outreach messages to hit ~15 replies -> ~12 accepts. Will prioritize companies with existing infra maturity.
Olivia (Research): Quick poll for metric weighting: propose weights: time-to-first-success 40%, telemetry stability 30%, qualitative satisfaction 30%. Agree?
Marco (Eng): agree
Ashley (PM): agree
Jamal (Recruiter): lgtm :thumbsup:
Ashley (PM): Great — locking plan. We'll reconvene Tue 9am to review candidate shortlist and the Typeform results.
Tina (Design): If anyone has onboarding examples or checklists from previous pilots, drop links here.
Marco (Eng): Dropping infra notes in the doc: https://go.redwood.internal/private-preview/infra-plan (internal)
Olivia (Research): I'll prepare a 6-week survey cadence and the interview guide; want to keep interview length <=30min.
Jamal (Recruiter): I'll also add a short pre-screen call script: 10 min, confirm use-case, confirm commitment, and capture sample prompts.
Ashley (PM): Thanks all. Final ask: please add any hard blockers in the doc by EOD so we can adjust timeline if needed.
